name: com.helpcrunch.library.core.HCFirebaseMessagingService
description: The HelpCrunch chat SDK receives Firebase notifications through this service. When Firebase delivers a HelpCrunch message or refreshes the registration token, the service passes the message to HelpCrunch and updates notification registration.
disableEffect: HelpCrunch push messages will no longer be handled or have their registration refreshed; the app's other screens remain available.
